accounting.tokens: Sum of separately tokenized initialize instructions, full tool definitions (including output schemas), user prompts, tools/call request objects, and actual MCP text responses. Import commands and their stdout are counted in ingestion. Requests are model-output-like; responses and definitions are model-input-like. This is payload accounting, not measured provider billing.
accounting.full_result_json_tokens: Same accounting, replacing text responses with full CallToolResult JSON, including structuredContent duplication. Host behavior varies.
accounting.raw_baseline: User question plus every raw CSV row or document in each independent session. Counterfactual token volume; large cases may not fit a model context window.
accounting.direct_controls: Local DuckDB and targeted file access show that ordinary tools can also avoid putting raw data in context. Workspool's additional benefit is persisted references, checkpoints, versions, and freshness.
accounting.excluded: No LLM inference, model reasoning or final-answer tokens, chat role framing, prompt caching, SDK initialize/list_tools wire envelopes, host-specific wrappers, Mac/MLX speed or memory claims. No claims about end-to-end task quality from scripted tool selection.
accounting.fixtures: Deterministic synthetic data, fixed random seeds. Correct results checked independently in Python; no real market or personal data.

direct_local_sql_control.scope: Executed local DuckDB control; canonical shell schema and command/result payload, no model inference.
